11th Level Clan Feature

The Kashu clan's most technically demanding technique is not a jutsu. It is a piece of music. A sustained composition played at a frequency so precisely calibrated to a living creature's biological and chakra resonance that it turns their own body into a weapon against them.

As an Action, you can begin to play your Shinobi Instrument, creating your Killing Frequency. Your Killing Frequency is a sustained state that lasts for up to 1 minute. Your Killing Frequency fills a radius based on the source you choose for its duration;

30-foot radius centered on you, and moves with you.

20-foot radius centered on one of your Doki. You can switch which Doki the Killing Frequency is centered on at the beginning of each of your turns.

10-foot radius centered on all active Bell Wires.

While your Killing Frequency is up, you gain the following abilities: Effects that trigger when a hostile creature performs an action such as cast a jutsu or move can only be used once per turn. They cannot all be used at the same time and once an effect has been used it cannot be used until the next creatures turn. Once you activate your Killing Frequency feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.

Embedded Frequency. Twice per turn, hostile creatures that cast a Jutsu with the Hand Seal (HS) or Mobility (M) components within your Killing Frequency, must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain a rank of Disoriented.

Chakra Interference. Once per turn, when a hostile creature attempts to cast a jutsu with the Chakra Molding (CM) component within your Killing Frequency, they must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they increase the cost of the jutsu cast by +8.

Sonic Pulse. Once per turn, when a hostile creature with ranks of Disoriented moves more than 10 feet within your Killing Frequency on their turn, they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they take 2d6 psychic damage, for each rank of Disoriented they have.

Discordant Broadcast. Once per turn, when a hostile creature begins their turn maintaining concentrating on a jutsu or effect within your Killing Frequency they must make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they must choose to either triple their concentration chakra cost (if any) or lose concentration.
